title: 学校前台来电：孩子发烧要你来接
titleEn: The school office calls: your child is sick
scene: 周三上午十一点，你正在公司开会，手机响了，是孩子小学的前台 Donna 打来的。你上 Year 1 的女儿 Mia 说头疼，在 sick bay 躺着，量了体温有点烧。Donna 说话很快、很亲切，但一口气会说好几件事：体温多少、能不能给药、什么时候来接、明天能不能上学。
你的目标：① 听懂孩子现在什么情况、体温多少；② 回答能不能给退烧药，说清你大概几点能到、谁来接；③ 弄明白接孩子的流程（到前台签字）和回校规定（24 小时不发烧），最后请她短信确认。

facts.v: 12:00 左右 · 前台签字带走
24 小时不发烧（不靠吃药退烧）

vocab.ex: Hi, it's Donna from the front office at Prospect Primary.
She's having a lie-down in the sick bay.

vocab.zh: 发烧（temp 是 temperature 的口语缩写）
vocab.ex: She's running a bit of a temp.

vocab.zh: 脸色不好、看着不太舒服
vocab.ex: She's been a bit off colour since recess.
She's just a bit under the weather, nothing serious.
Her teacher noticed it straight after recess.

vocab.zh: 来把她接走（grab 很口语）
vocab.ex: Are you able to come and grab her?
You'll just need to sign her out at the front office.
We can't give her Panadol without your consent.
She needs to be 24 hours symptom-free before she comes back.

vocab.en: mark her absent / log the absence
vocab.ex: You can log the absence on the school app.
We'll keep an eye on her till you get here.

listening.en: Hi, is that Mia's mum? It's Donna from the front office — nothing to panic about, she's okay.
listening.sound: is that → "izzat"；front office 连读成 "fron-toffice"。开头先说 nothing to panic about，是让你别紧张
listening.zh: 你好，是 Mia 的妈妈吗？我是前台的 Donna——别紧张，她没事。
listening.reply: Hi Donna, yes, speaking. Is everything alright?

listening.en: She's been a bit off colour since recess, so we've popped her in the sick bay.
listening.sound: off colour → "o-fculler"；popped her in → "pop-der-in"，her 的 h 吞掉
listening.zh: 她从课间开始就看着不太舒服，我们就让她在医务室躺着了。
listening.reply: Oh, poor thing. What's wrong with her?

listening.en: She's running a bit of a temp — thirty-eight point two — and she reckons her head's sore.
listening.sound: a bit of a → "a bidda"；thirty-eight point two 说得很快，就是 38.2；reckons = 说/觉得
listening.zh: 她有点发烧——38.2 度——她说头疼。
listening.reply: Sorry, was that thirty-eight point two?

listening.en: We're not allowed to give her any Panadol unless we've got your consent, so would you like us to?
listening.sound: not allowed to → "nod-a-lowd-a"；Panadol 是澳洲最常见的扑热息痛品牌，相当于退烧药
listening.zh: 没有你的同意我们不能给她吃 Panadol，你希望我们给吗？
listening.reply: Yes, that's fine. She's had it before with no problems.

listening.en: Are you right to come and grab her, or is there someone else on the list who can?
listening.sound: are you right to → "ya-right-a"，意思是"你方便…吗"；on the list = 授权接孩子名单
listening.zh: 你方便来接她吗？还是名单上有别人可以来？
listening.reply: I'm at work, but I can be there in about forty minutes.

listening.en: Just pop into the front office and sign her out — no need to go down to the classroom.
listening.zh: 直接到前台签字把她接走就行——不用去教室。
listening.reply: Got it. I'll come straight to the front office.

speech.topic: 说说孩子在学校生病时，我是怎么一边上班一边处理的
paragraphs: Today I want to talk about a day when my daughter got sick at school. It was a Wednesday morning and I was in a meeting at work. My phone rang, and it was the front office at her school. The lady on the phone told me my daughter was a bit off colour and had a temperature of thirty-eight point two. She was lying down in the sick bay.

At first I felt worried, but the lady was very calm and kind. She asked me if they could give her Panadol, and I said yes. Then she asked if I could come and pick her up. I told her I could be there in about forty minutes. I also asked her to say a few things again more slowly, because she was speaking very fast and I didn't want to miss anything.

After the call, I told my manager what was going on. In Australia, most managers are very understanding about this. I packed up my laptop, drove to the school and signed my daughter out at the front office. She looked tired, but she gave me a big smile.

I learned two useful things that day. First, the school has a rule: a child needs to be twenty-four hours without a fever before going back. Second, it's important to keep the school's list of emergency contacts up to date, in case I can't leave work.
Now I feel much more confident on the phone. If I don't catch something, I just ask, "Sorry, could you say that again?" Most people are happy to help.
speech.zh: 我讲了一次孩子在学校生病的经历：周三上午我在开会，学校前台打电话说女儿不舒服、发烧 38.2 度，在医务室躺着。我一开始很担心，但前台很冷静友好。她问能不能给孩子吃 Panadol，我同意了；她问我能不能来接，我说四十分钟左右到。因为她说得快，我请她慢一点重复。挂电话后我跟经理说明情况，开车去学校在前台签字接走了孩子。我学到两点：孩子要 24 小时不发烧才能回校；要及时更新学校的紧急联系人名单。现在我打电话更有信心了，听不清就直接请对方再说一遍。

patterns.zh: 她从……开始就有点……（描述症状开始时间）如 a bit off colour since recess

patterns.en: I can be there in about ___.
patterns.zh: 我大概……后能到（如 forty minutes / half an hour）

patterns.en: Would it be okay if ___ picks her up instead?
Just to confirm, she needs to ___ before she comes back?
patterns.zh: 确认一下，她回学校之前需要……对吗？

lines.en: Hi, is that Mia's mum? It's Donna from the front office at Prospect Primary. Nothing to panic about, she's okay.
lines.zh: 你好，是 Mia 的妈妈吗？我是 Prospect 小学前台的 Donna。别紧张，她没事。

lines.en: Hi Donna, yes, speaking. I'm just stepping out of a meeting. Is everything alright?
lines.zh: 你好 Donna，是我。我刚从会议里出来。一切还好吗？

lines.en: Yeah, look, she's been a bit off colour since recess, so her teacher sent her up and we've popped her in the sick bay. She's running a bit of a temp, thirty-eight point two, and she reckons her head's pretty sore.
lines.zh: 嗯，是这样，她从课间就看着不太舒服，老师让她来前台，我们让她在医务室躺着了。她有点发烧，38.2 度，她说头挺疼的。

lines.en: Oh no, poor thing. Sorry, could you say the temperature again a bit slower?
lines.zh: 哎呀，可怜的孩子。不好意思，体温能再慢一点说一遍吗？

lines.en: Sure, no worries. Thirty-eight point two. So not super high, but high enough that we can't really keep her in class.
lines.zh: 当然，没问题。38.2 度。不算特别高，但已经不能让她留在教室了。

lines.en: Okay, I understand. Has she been sick at all, like vomiting?
lines.zh: 好的，明白。她有没有吐？

lines.en: No, no vomiting, thank goodness. She's just lying down with a cold pack and a cup of water. She's a bit teary, but she's alright.
lines.zh: 没有，没吐，还好。她就躺着敷着冰袋，喝了点水。有点想哭，但还好。

lines.en: Now, we're not allowed to give her any Panadol unless we've got your consent. Would you like us to give her a dose while she's waiting?
lines.zh: 另外，没有你的同意我们不能给她吃 Panadol。你希望我们在她等的时候给她吃一次吗？

lines.en: Yes, please, that's fine. She's had Panadol before with no problems. She hasn't had any today.
lines.zh: 好的，可以。她以前吃过 Panadol，没问题。她今天还没吃过。

lines.en: Lovely, I'll note that down. And are you right to come and grab her, or is there someone else on the list who can?
lines.zh: 好的，我记下来。那你方便来接她吗？还是名单上有别人可以来？

lines.en: I'm at work in the city, but I can leave now. I should be there in about forty minutes, so around twelve.
lines.zh: 我在市区上班，不过我现在可以走。大概四十分钟能到，差不多十二点。

lines.en: That's fine, no rush. Drive safe. We'll keep an eye on her till you get here.
lines.zh: 可以，别着急。路上小心。你到之前我们会看着她。

lines.en: Thank you. When I get there, do I need to go to her classroom?
lines.zh: 谢谢。我到了以后需要去她教室吗？

lines.en: Nah, just pop into the front office and sign her out on the iPad at the desk. She'll be right here with me, and her bag's already up here too.
lines.zh: 不用，直接来前台，在桌上的 iPad 签字接走就行。她就在我这儿，书包也已经拿上来了。

lines.en: Great. Just to confirm, I sign her out at the front office, not the classroom?
lines.zh: 好的。确认一下，我是在前台签字，不是在教室，对吗？

lines.en: That's it, spot on. Oh, and just a heads-up — with a temp, she'll need to be twenty-four hours symptom-free before she comes back, and that's without any Panadol bringing it down.
lines.zh: 对，没错。哦，还要提醒你一下——发烧的话，她要 24 小时没症状才能回来，而且不能是吃药压下去的。

lines.en: Sorry, I didn't quite catch the last part. Do you mean no fever for a full day without medicine?
lines.zh: 不好意思，最后那部分我没太听清。你是说不吃药的情况下一整天不发烧吗？

lines.en: Yep, exactly. So realistically, she'll probably be home tomorrow. You can log the absence on the school app, and that'll go straight to her teacher.
lines.zh: 对，就是这样。所以实际上她明天大概要在家。你可以在学校 app 上登记缺勤，会直接发给她老师。

lines.en: Okay, I'll do that tonight. Could you also send me a quick text with the pick-up details, just so I've got it in writing?
lines.zh: 好的，我今晚登记。你能再给我发条短信写一下接孩子的安排吗？这样我有个书面记录。

lines.en: Yeah, can do. Is it still 0491 570 156?
Yes, that's right. And can you tell Mia I'm on my way?
lines.zh: 对，没错。你能告诉 Mia 我已经在路上了吗？

lines.en: Will do. She'll be stoked. Alright, see you soon, love.
lines.zh: 好的。她肯定会很开心。好，一会儿见。

lines.en: Thanks so much, Donna. I really appreciate you looking after her. See you soon.
lines.zh: 非常感谢你，Donna，谢谢你照顾她。一会儿见。

rescue.en: Sorry, could you say that again a bit slower?
rescue.zh: 不好意思，能再慢一点说一遍吗？

rescue.en: Sorry, was that thirty-eight point two?
rescue.zh: 不好意思，是 38.2 度吗？（重复数字确认）

rescue.en: Sorry, I didn't quite catch the last part.
rescue.zh: 不好意思，最后那部分我没太听清。

rescue.en: Could you send me a quick text with the details?
rescue.zh: 你能把细节发短信给我吗？

checklist: 我听懂了 off colour、run a temp、sick bay，知道孩子现在什么情况
我听清并复述了体温 38.2（thirty-eight point two）
我能清楚回答能不能给 Panadol（consent）
我说出了大概几点到（I can be there in about forty minutes）
我弄明白了要在前台 sign her out，以及 24 hours symptom-free 才能回校
对话中我至少礼貌追问了两次，并请对方短信确认
